HON.definition: Speaker urges or describes keeping covenants already made as the condition for blessing or protection.
HON.include: Keeping, being true to, clinging to, or renewing covenants; baptism as covenant entry.
HON.exclude: Explanation of how a covenant is ratified (-> holy spirit of promise); ancestral covenants (-> generational covenant reach).

NAM.definition: Covenant to take upon oneself the name of Christ, framed as becoming rather than labeling.
NAM.include: Name-of-Christ language tied to identity or service.
NAM.exclude: Generic discipleship without the name motif.

SAC.definition: The weekly sacrament as covenant renewal, protection, or reset.
SAC.include: Any substantive treatment of the sacrament ordinance.

HSP.definition: The Holy Ghost ratifying ordinances and covenants as binding.
HSP.include: Explicit Holy Spirit of Promise doctrine.
HSP.exclude: Holy Ghost as comforter or guide (-> comfort of holy ghost / discerning the spirit).

CRD.definition: Ordinances and covenants framed as required credentials whose validity depends on ongoing faithfulness.
CRD.exclude: Ratification by the Spirit (-> holy spirit of promise).

MAR.definition: Eternal marriage and sealing as covenant commitment.
MAR.exclude: Family as a teaching pattern (-> family as divine pattern).

GEN.definition: Covenants made by earlier generations continue to act on posterity, or a person's faith becomes a legacy for descendants.
GEN.include: Ancestors' covenants reaching descendants; faith legacy across generations.
GEN.exclude: Family history research as an activity (-> family history work).

FHW.definition: Gathering names and performing ordinances for deceased family.
FHW.exclude: Ancestral faith stories without ordinance work (-> generational covenant reach).

FND.definition: Assurance that another person's choices cannot strip a faithful covenant keeper of promised blessings.
FND.include: Explicit no-loss assurance for the faithful party.
FND.exclude: General hope for wayward loved ones (-> loving the wayward).

TMP.definition: Temple attendance, service, dedication, or culture as worship.
TMP.include: Temple as place, practice, or announcement.
TMP.exclude: Temple as a priority test in scripture (-> temple as priority).

TPR.definition: Neglect or prioritization of the Lord's house as the hinge of blessing (Haggai pattern).
TPR.exclude: Ordinary temple attendance counsel (-> temple worship).

AGR.definition: Trials framed as refining, shaping, or purposeful for the sufferer.
AGR.include: Suffering that 'gives purpose', 'for thy good', sculpting.
AGR.exclude: Statements that trials will come without purpose framing (-> trials not removed).

TNR.definition: Explicit correction of the expectation that faithfulness prevents hardship.
TNR.include: Umbrella vs rock; promises are not removal of challenges; obedience does not exempt from trial.
TNR.exclude: Purpose of trial (-> adversity as growth).

TST.definition: Mortality designed as a test of faith or obedience.
TST.include: Explicit test framing; catalogues of mortal trials.
TST.exclude: Purposive refinement language (-> adversity as growth).

WHY.definition: Speaker models replacing 'why me' with a purpose- or learning-oriented question.
WHY.include: 'Why' to 'what is supposed to be happening' or 'what can I learn'.
WHY.exclude: Normalizing the asking of questions (-> questions are not sin).

TWU.definition: Holding belief while explicitly lacking explanation.
TWU.include: 'Not understanding is not the same as not believing'; 'I do not know the meaning of all things'.
TWU.exclude: Trust in specific promises (-> trusting god's promises).

TGP.definition: Invitation or modeling of reliance on God's promises.
TGP.include: Promises as reliable; standing on the promises.
TGP.exclude: Promise extended by the speaker (-> apostolic promise).

DGT.definition: Help arrives in the Lord's own time and way, sometimes delayed or postponed to the resurrection.
DGT.include: Timing and manner of deliverance; waiting upon the Lord.
DGT.exclude: Christ as deliverer without timing (-> christ as deliverer).

QNS.definition: Normalizing heartrending questions and emotions in trial.
QNS.include: Explicit statement that questions or emotions are not weakness.

HND.definition: God's purposes become visible later or in eternity.
HND.include: Looking back from the mountains; 'someday we will realize'.
HND.exclude: Present comfort (-> comfort of holy ghost).

PWO.definition: Peace promised even when the hoped-for result does not come.
PWO.include: Explicit decoupling of peace from outcome.
PWO.exclude: Peace through deliverance (-> deliverance in god's time).

REM.definition: Recalling past mercies as the basis for present trust.
REM.exclude: Gratitude as virtue (-> gratitude over entitlement).

DBT.definition: Addressing uncertainty or weakened testimony with counsel to persist.
DBT.include: Doubt, uncertain testimony, diminishing faith counsel.
DBT.exclude: Grief questions (-> questions are not sin).

SCI.definition: Scientific and spiritual methods of knowledge framed as ultimately non-conflicting.
SCI.include: Science/religion reconciliation; secular learning vs spiritual horizon.

LOS.definition: Story of death, loss, or catastrophic trial told by or about a named person.
LOS.include: Death of child or parent, loss of baby, disaster.

CFX.definition: The limit-of-control moment named in the speaker's own words.
CFX.include: Explicit 'I can't fix this' or equivalent.
CFX.exclude: General self-reliance limits (-> limits of self-reliance).

RES.definition: Literal resurrection reframing death and mortal limitation.
RES.exclude: Spirit world and plan (-> plan of salvation).

CMF.definition: Holy Ghost as Comforter in loss.
CMF.include: Comforter language; priesthood blessing of peace.
CMF.exclude: Holy Ghost as guide or feeling to follow (-> discerning the spirit).

CRB.definition: Christ bears griefs, sorrows, sins, or loads on our behalf.
CRB.include: Carrying, yoke, bearing griefs, 'I've got this'.

LFT.definition: Christ raises people out of despair or sin; light that rescues.
LFT.include: Lift, raise up, light in darkness.

CCS.definition: Christ knows our pains by experience and therefore can succor.
CCS.include: Succor, 'knows how we feel', descended below all.
CCS.exclude: Christ acting to rescue (-> christ as deliverer).

DEL.definition: Christ delivers from affliction, death, and hell.
DEL.exclude: Timing of deliverance (-> deliverance in god's time).

RCR.definition: Redemption rests on Christ's merit, not our own.
RCR.include: Explicit contrast of our righteousness and His.
RCR.exclude: Grace as enabling power (-> enabling grace).

GRC.definition: Grace as divine strength that enables endurance and growth beyond our own capacity.
GRC.include: Enabling power, strength beyond own, lengthening stride.
GRC.exclude: Forgiveness-focused atonement statements (-> atonement and resurrection).

ATN.definition: Doctrinal witness of the Atonement and Resurrection as facts.
ATN.include: Gethsemane, cross, empty tomb as declared truth.

CHA.definition: Christ named as the single answer to varied problems.
CHA.include: 'The answer is always Jesus Christ' and close variants.

IDH.definition: Choosing to ask, invite, or surrender to divine intervention.
IDH.include: Asking for help, turning despair over to Christ.
IDH.exclude: Turning direction of life (-> turning toward god).

PRD.include: 'I didn't want help'; pride gets in the way.
PRD.exclude: Self-reliance as cultural training (-> limits of self-reliance).

SRL.exclude: Specific 'I can't fix this' (-> "i can't fix this").

WMS.definition: Inadequacy as the condition God works through.
WMS.include: Weak and simple, 'do I have the right person', Ether 12:27.
WMS.exclude: Identity labels (-> labels vs eternal identity).

TRN.definition: Agency exercised to turn toward rather than away from God in trial.
TRN.include: Turn to Him, choose Christ, any time we turn.
TRN.exclude: Request for help (-> inviting divine help).

TCH.definition: Humility defined as receptivity, a broken heart, or teachableness.
TCH.include: Humility, broken heart, receptive to God's will.
TCH.exclude: Pride as obstacle (-> pride resisting help).

BST.definition: Effort, not perfection, is what is asked; daily trying.
BST.include: 'Do the very best he can', 'daily trying', 'every step matters'.
BST.exclude: Perseverance against quitting (-> never give up).

CAY.definition: One comes to Christ to be perfected, not after; unworthiness is the adversary's sign.
CAY.include: Perfection is pending; trespassers sign removed.

WIP.definition: Patience with self and others as all are mid-path.
WIP.include: 'We are all a work in progress'.

NGU.include: 'Don't ever give up', 'we fail only when we give up'.
NGU.exclude: Doing one's best without quitting frame (-> doing one's best).

LLD.definition: Discipleship as a long arc beyond single milestones.

CRG.definition: Courage born of faith to act rightly under pressure.

DRF.definition: Imperceptible decline through neglect of practices.
DRF.exclude: Return after drift (-> never too late).

NTL.definition: Return is always possible; no one beyond reach.
NTL.include: Prodigal, always a way back, today a new day.

RPT.definition: Invitation to repent or description of repentance, including daily repentance.

SEE.definition: Truly noticing a person, especially one others overlook.
SEE.include: 'I see you', eyes to see, seeing past labels.

APT.definition: Ordinary encounters reframed as God-arranged opportunities.

NME.definition: Knowing someone's name as an act of recognition.
NME.exclude: Name of Christ (-> taking christ's name).

QHS.code: quick to help slow to judge
QHS.definition: Help offered without judgment of the person's history.
QHS.include: 'Quick to help and slow to judge'; look to their possible.

TAP.definition: God fulfills His promises to succor primarily through other people.
TAP.include: Kimball 'through another person', disciples help Him keep promises, earthly 'Teds'.
TAP.exclude: Human ministering without divine-agency framing (-> ministering with compassion).

MIN.definition: Acts of compassionate care toward others.

SVC.definition: Serving others changes the one who serves.
SVC.include: 'Time did not change, the missionaries did'.

WAY.definition: Responding to loved ones who left with love, prayer, and patience rather than pressure.
WAY.exclude: Doctrine that faithful are not deprived (-> faithful not deprived).

COG.definition: Eternal identity as a child of heavenly parents.

POT.definition: Who one can become; a work to do.

LBL.definition: Worldly labels contrasted with eternal identity.

FAM.definition: Family as the pattern through which God's love is taught.

PLN.definition: God's plan of happiness as frame for mortality.
PLN.include: Plan of happiness, premortal, spirit world.

UNL.definition: God's love cannot be earned or lost; relentless pursuit.
UNL.include: Unconditional love, beholding him loved him.
UNL.exclude: Love that is not license (-> warning against deception).

AST.definition: Promises apply to me too; no personal exception.

GKY.definition: God knows the individual's location, name, story.
GKY.include: 'He has your exact location', knows your story.

PCL.definition: Choosing words that build peace; forgoing contention in speech.

CTN.definition: Contention identified as not of Christ; avoiding contentious settings.

UNI.definition: Unity across divisions as the fruit of coming to Christ.
UNI.include: One in Christ, bridges not walls.

COA.definition: Critique of crude, bullying public and online discourse.
COA.exclude: Device harms generally (-> digital technology risks).

FRG.definition: Forgiving people who have wronged us.

TWL.definition: Holding truth and love together in engagement with others.

LNC.definition: Love does not exempt from commandments or sanction choices.
LNC.include: Love is not sanctioning; forgive vs condone.

DEC.definition: Naming adversarial lies (love as license, unworthiness, division, low self-worth).

CND.definition: Grace or salvation tied to stated conditions.
CND.include: Comply with conditions; covenants as only way.

AGY.definition: Agency as each person's right and responsibility to choose.

INT.definition: Integrity and virtue as foundations of happiness.
INT.include: Integrity, virtue, doing not only saying.

SSP.definition: Ordinary practices as the source of great outcomes.

SCS.exclude: Book of Mormon as unique witness (-> book of mormon power).

PRY.definition: Prayer as practice or turning point.
PRY.exclude: Fasting with prayer (-> law of the fast).

CON.definition: Consistency and sincerity matter more than technique.

SPR.definition: Attending to the Holy Ghost's influence as guidance.
SPR.include: Feel lift, constant companionship as priority.
SPR.exclude: Comfort in grief (-> comfort of holy ghost).

STL.definition: Protecting stillness, sleep, and undistracted attention.

DIG.definition: Smartphones, social media, online platforms as spiritual or social risks.
DIG.include: Phones, social media, artificial information, mobile gambling.

PRI.definition: Not letting good or lesser things crowd out the essential.
PRI.include: Avoid distraction; act well thy part; good things crowd out.

TTH.definition: Tithing as commandment, test, or source of blessing.

POR.definition: Fast offerings and relief of the poor.

CNS.definition: Giving self and means wholly to God's kingdom.

NOX.definition: The law applies even to the poorest.

ALN.definition: Aligning desires, priorities, or ways with God's will.

SUB.definition: Blessings that are real but easily overlooked.
SUB.include: Significant but subtle blessings; lists of blessings.

PRE.definition: Blessings follow obedience to the law on which they are predicated.

OLV.definition: Keep commandments because we love God, not only for reward.

GRT.definition: Gratitude as a corrective to entitlement and a way to see blessings.

GMB.definition: Gambling named as harmful and morally wrong.

OPP.definition: Choices evaluated by what they displace.

STW.definition: Resources as stewardships to be used productively.
STW.include: Work vs idle pursuits; giving vs taking path.

EXM.definition: Concern for how one's example affects weaker others.

TSM.definition: Bearing, sharing, or nurturing personal testimony.

APW.definition: Special witness of apostles as foundation.

BOM.definition: Book of Mormon as converting or universal witness.

TLV.definition: Gospel teaching rooted in love for learners and the Master.
TLV.include: 'To teach like the Savior, we must love like the Savior'.

PRO.definition: Prophets and keys valued; not taken lightly.
PRO.exclude: Following a specific prophetic invitation (-> following prophetic counsel).

RST.definition: First Vision and restoration of keys and truths.

FPC.definition: Acting on a specific invitation from the living prophet.

DOC.definition: Formal declaration of the Godhead and the Church's identity.

ICH.definition: Inviting others to come unto Christ.
ICH.include: Love, share, invite; find one person.

UNV.definition: God's grace and invitation extend to all people everywhere.

GRW.definition: Reports of record growth or worldwide hunger.

ANA.definition: A sustained secular analogy carries the doctrine.
ANA.include: Cold oatmeal, gliding, passport, buttons, ultramarathon, immunity, GPS.

SCR.definition: Scripture story or text used as model.

QLD.definition: Quotes or attributes teaching to a named Church leader.

INV.definition: Speaker issues a direct invitation to act.

PRM.definition: Speaker extends a promise of blessing.

EMP.definition: Survey statistics or market data cited.

XRF.definition: Explicit reference to another talk given this same conference weekend.
XRF.exclude: Quotes of earlier conferences (-> quoting church leaders).

C01 covenant keeping.justification: No adoption construct names a two-party binding promise renewed over time.

C02 covenant mechanics.justification: Doctrinal mechanics (ratification, validity) have no analogue in the dictionary.

C03 covenant reach.justification: Intergenerational effects of a commitment on non-parties are absent from UTAUT, Theory of Trying, and Effective Use.

C04 temple.justification: 'As temples come closer... we can come to the temple more often' (T01.15): infrastructure enabling use.

C05 adversity reframed.justification: Affect about the striving itself: 'the only way to get it is to go through it' (T02.04).

C06 trust amid uncertainty.justification: Trust under non-explanation exceeds anticipated-success affect; flagged as a partial fit.

C07 grief and comfort.justification: Bereavement and comfort fall outside all three frameworks.

C08 christ as agent.justification: Belief that support exists for the attempt; cross-context transfer, flagged as analogy.

C09 receiving help.justification: Pride as a barrier to help-seeking is not named in the dictionary.

C10 effort over perfection.theory_construct: Trying; reducing attitude toward failure (Theory of Trying)
C10 effort over perfection.justification: Goal framed as trying; 'We fail only when we give up' (T18.21) relocates failure from outcome to quitting.

C11 drift and return.justification: Automaticity decays through neglect: 'We rarely intend to sink' (T15.17).

C12 seeing the one.justification: Noticing the individual is a helper-side behavior with no dictionary construct.

C13 god works through people.justification: Mediated divine agency: promised help delivered through third parties; two speakers independently cite the same Kimball line.

C14 divine identity.justification: Identity claims are outside adoption theory.

C15 personal divine love.justification: Unearned love is not modeled in the dictionary.

C16 peacemaking.justification: Speech norms and unity have no adoption construct.

C17 truth boundaries.justification: Balancing truth and love is outside the dictionary.

C18 devotional practices.theory_construct: Learning actions; effective vs mere use (Effective Use)
C18 devotional practices.justification: 'Consistency and sincerity' over method (T32.13); adding vs taking Christ's name (T22.05) parallels use vs effective use.

C19 guarding attention.justification: Phones and noise impede access to what matters; stillness restores it (T21.09).

C20 sacrificial laws.justification: Explicit cost-benefit trade-off: the widow's objection 'made sense from a worldly perspective' (T12.04).

C21 recognizing blessings.justification: Recalibrating expected gains toward 'significant but subtle' blessings (T30.07).

C22 case against gambling.justification: Speaker counters hedonic appeal ('even for fun') with opportunity cost.

C23 witness.justification: Others' testimony as a driver of belief adoption.

C24 prophets and restoration.justification: Authority source rather than peers; partial fit.

C25 gathering.justification: Invitation and universal reach extend beyond peer influence.

C26 rhetorical moves.justification: Promises and invitations parallel 'reducing anticipated failure' and eliciting intention to try.
